validation_requirement: Missing/stale states block and are counted.

frozen_rule: current funding compared against 180 prior completed observations, excluding current value
validation_requirement: Avoids leakage and self-referential percentile ranks.

frozen_rule: entries before 180 prior funding observations are blocked
validation_requirement: Count warmup-blocked entries separately from positive-extreme blocks.

validation_requirement: BTC funding diagnostic-only, not basket anchor gate.
